# CommonMark 0.31.2 test corpus

`spec.json` is the official CommonMark 0.31.2 example corpus, copied without
modification from <https://spec.commonmark.org/0.31.2/spec.json>.

The CommonMark specification and its corpus are by John MacFarlane and are
licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
License (CC BY-SA 4.0). The complete official legal code is included in
`LICENSE.txt`; its source is
<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode.txt>.
This corpus copy is unmodified. The attribution and license apply to the
corpus, not to Goldmark or Markitect.

SHA-256: `d431b29d97b6f73e69d547109cf5081578fac931e72afe95639ebe766c1b2a20`

`LICENSE.txt` contains the complete official CC BY-SA 4.0 legal code with its
trailing empty line removed. The upstream file's SHA-256 is
`28a9529c7d0bb4dc51f4bf5c116a3d16ef247a052f7591466768ddf563fd1cf5`.

The test runs all examples against unextended Goldmark with its XHTML renderer
and raw HTML enabled. The pinned corpus contains 652 examples. This records
renderer baseline compatibility only; it does not claim that Markitect's
body-link extension has CommonMark conformance.
